# Composer canned picker — M3 guidance

<!-- Generated by apps/site/scripts/one-off/migrate-guidance.mjs. Do not edit by hand.
     The component pages carry the reference; this file carries the guidance. -->

## Web

### Features

Reach for the composer canned picker when the reply is faster written in advance: a library of canned responses inserted into the draft. The inserts are data — id, title, body — so the whole library is one declaration, and each row renders through the picker option contract with the title naming it and the body as supporting text. There is no second option list anywhere: the picker composes `KernPicker` in option-list mode, an inline popover on web, so picking one is picking from the same rows the picker owns. `onCannedSelect` receives the insert while writing it into the draft stays host-owned, and library curation lives wherever the inserts come from, because there is no insert editing here.

## Native

### Features

Reach for the composer canned picker when the reply is faster written in advance: a library of canned responses inserted into the draft — the native twin under the same contract. The inserts are data — id, title, body — so the whole library is one declaration, and each row renders through the picker option contract with the title naming it and the body as supporting text. There is no second option list anywhere: the picker composes `KernPicker` in option-list mode through an owned-trigger sheet on native, so picking one is picking from the same rows the picker owns. `onCannedSelect` receives the insert while writing it into the draft stays host-owned, and there is no insert editing — library curation lives wherever the inserts come from.
